verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a code-hosting platform, but the evidence pack documents no export of repositories, pull requests, issues or comments in open formats. The only migration tool documented moves data into Bitbucket Cloud, not out of it. One community report shows a departing user planning to save static HTML of PR pages, which is a user-side workaround rather than a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
